Name: Soap and Scrub - Immersive Hygiene System
Author: AnnaCharles
Description:
[center][b][size=6]Soap & Scrub[/size][/b][/center]
[center][i]Sparkly when clean. Stinky when dirty. Simple as that.[/i][/center]

[center]Take a bath and your farmer gets a cute sparkling [b]Clean[/b] effect.[/center]
[center]Skip bathing for an entire day and you may wake up the next morning pretty stinky.[/center]
[center]No percentages.[/center]
[center]No hygiene meter.[/center]
[center]No complicated survival system.[/center]
[center]Just try not to smell. 😅[/center]
[center]
[color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b]A little support goes a long way.[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b] Endorsements, comments, and feedback help these mods grow and inspire what comes next.[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b] Thanks for being part of it.[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[/center]



🧼 [b]HOW IT WORKS[/b]
Craft a [b]Soap Scrub[/b] using:
[b]10 Fiber + 1 Any Flower[/b]
Then use it inside your farmhouse or near a valid water source to take a bath.
Soap Scrub can also be purchased from:
[list]
[*][b]Pierre’s General Store — 20g[/b][/*]
[*][b]JojaMart — 20g[/b][/*]
[/list]

✨ [b]CLEAN[/b]
By default, bathing gives you [b]Clean[/b] for 2 in-game hours.
While Clean:
[list]
[*]Your farmer gets a sparkling visual effect[/*]
[*]Talking to villagers gives [b]+20 Friendship[/b][/*]
[*]Bathing again refreshes the Clean timer[/*]
[/list]Bathing works at normal supported water sources, the Spa / Hot Springs, and supported swimming states.


🐝 [b]BEES PLUS COMPATIBILITY[/b]
If you have [b]Bees Plus[/b] installed, its soap items can be combined with Soap Scrub for a deeper clean.
[list]
[*][b]Soap Scrub only[/b] → Clean for 2 hours[/*]
[*][b]Soap Scrub + Soap[/b] → Clean for 4 hours[/*]
[*][b]Soap Scrub + Floral Soap[/b] → Clean for 6 hours and [b]+1 Defense[/b][/*]
[/list]This is an [b]optional, specific integration[/b] and Soap & Scrub works normally without Bees Plus installed.
[b]Special thanks to omena007[/b] for the [b]Soap Scrub sponge sprite[/b] and for giving permission for the Bees Plus integration.


🤢 [b]FORGOT TO BATHE?[/b]
Go an entire day without properly washing and you can wake up [b]Dirty[/b] the next morning.
You’ll probably notice.
Your farmer gets a very obvious green stinky cloud following them around.
While Dirty:
[list]
[*]Talking to villagers gives [b]-45 Friendship[/b][/*]
[*]Villagers can show a sick reaction[/*]
[*]You gain [b]+1 Farming[/b][/*]
[*]You gain [b]+1 Mining[/b][/*]
[*]You gain [b]+1 Combat[/b][/*]
[*]Dirty remains active until you clean yourself[/*]
[/list]The little skill bonuses are intentional.
You may smell terrible...
but apparently you’re getting things done. 😂


🌧️ [b]RAIN, SPA & SWIMMING[/b]
Getting thoroughly soaked can wash away the visible grime too.
While Dirty:
[list]
[*]Stay outside in rain for 10 in-game minutes → return to Normal[/*]
[*]Stay in Spa / Hot Springs water for 10 in-game minutes → return to Normal[/*]
[*]Supported swimming states can do the same[/*]
[/list]But there’s an important difference:
[b]Getting rinsed off does not count as a proper bath.[/b]
So even if the Dirty effect disappears, if you never actually use Soap Scrub that day, you can still wake up Dirty again the next morning.


🌲 [b]LINUS[/b]
Linus doesn’t care.
Clean or Dirty, he does not receive Soap & Scrub’s hygiene-based friendship bonus, friendship penalty, or sick reaction.
He’s got his priorities sorted.


💚 [b]WHY SOAP & SCRUB?[/b]
I wanted hygiene to exist without turning Stardew Valley into a survival game.
No hygiene percentage slowly ticking down.
No meter to babysit.
No constant maintenance.
Just two easy states:
[b]Clean → Sparkly[/b]
[b]Dirty → Stinky[/b]
You either washed...
or you didn’t.
That’s it.
📖 [b]WHERE THE IDEA CAME FROM[/b]
Soap & Scrub grew out of an older hygiene idea I originally posted on Nexus.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40811?tab=posts][b]Original hygiene idea discussion[/b][/url]
That idea later inspired another hygiene mod, and eventually I came back to the concept with the version I personally wanted to play:
[b]simple Clean and Dirty states, strong visual feedback, and no percentage meter.[/b]



📦 [b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b][/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b][/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] — Optional[/*]
[/list]

💡 [b]COMPATIBILITY / GAMEPLAY CLARIFICATION[/b]
Soap & Scrub is built around [b]Stardew Valley and SMAPI’s normal runtime systems[/b] and does not depend on another mod’s content for its core functionality.
Its hygiene mechanics use gameplay information already available through Stardew Valley, including player location, water and swimming states, time progression, buffs, skills, NPC interaction, and friendship.
When the player talks to an eligible villager while Clean or Dirty, Soap & Scrub can apply [b]its own temporary friendship effect and visual reaction[/b] as part of the hygiene mechanic.
[b]It does not generate, replace, copy, or rewrite the NPC’s dialogue, character writing, portraits, sprites, schedules, or other source content.[/b]
Clean and Dirty states, friendship effects, skill bonuses, visual effects, bathing rules, rain cleaning, Spa cleaning, and recovery are controlled by [b]the mod’s own programmed rules and configuration[/b].
The [b]Bees Plus[/b] feature is a deliberate optional integration made with permission. Soap & Scrub does not require Bees Plus and remains fully usable without it.
Other supported water or swimming behaviour is handled through runtime gameplay states rather than by copying or redistributing another mod’s maps, code, or assets.
[b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] is supported.

🤖 [b]AI DISCLOSURE[/b]
The [b]AI-Generated Content[/b] tag reflects the use of AI assistance during development of Soap & Scrub, including development of the mod’s code and some visual/UI assets created for the mod.
Some artwork and visual assets made specifically for Soap & Scrub were created with AI generation based on original concepts for the mod.
The [b]Soap Scrub sponge sprite credited to omena007[/b] was provided separately for the mod and is credited to its original creator.
The mod itself was designed, tested, balanced, adjusted, and assembled by me.
[b]Soap & Scrub does not use AI, an LLM, or any other generative system while Stardew Valley is running.[/b]
Clean and Dirty states, NPC reactions, friendship changes, bathing behaviour, skill effects, rain and water cleaning, and optional integrations are all controlled through predefined rules and programmed game logic.
AI does not generate NPC dialogue, responses, reactions, character content, buffs, events, or other gameplay content at runtime.
